title: cyperus unioloides f. insularis
intro: Cyperus unioloides f. insularis, commonly known as the Insular Sedge, is a plant species that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to aid in the treatment of various health issues such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Insular Sedge include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities.
